QR Code Ordering

Orders flow directly to the KDS, bypassing the POS for speed

Kitchen Display System (KDS)

Orders appear instantly on kitchen screens organized by station — grill, fryer, salad, dessert. Color-coded timers turn red when items are overdue. Course management ensures appetizers go out before mains. Managers get real-time kitchen performance dashboards.

Per-item cook timers with escalating visual alerts
Auto-routing to prep stations based on item type

Kitchen throughput analytics: items/hour, avg cook time

How It Works

From Scan to Satisfaction

A complete customer journey powered by NexDine — designed to reduce wait times, eliminate order errors, and increase revenue per table.

Step 01

Customer Scans QR Code

A unique QR code sits on every table. The customer opens their camera app, scans it, and the digital menu loads instantly in their browser. No app download, no registration, no friction.

Instant load (< 1 second)
Works on any smartphone
No data collection required

Browses & Customizes Order

The responsive digital menu showcases your dishes with photos, descriptions, modifiers, and dietary tags. Customers tap to add items, choose sizes, add extras, and write special instructions.
